title.en: compound adjectives (self-conscious, headstrong) · adverb + adjective collocations (deeply, utterly, mildly) · come across as / strike sb as

summary.es: compound adjectives (self-conscious, headstrong) · adverb + adjective collocations (deeply, utterly, mildly) · come across as / strike sb as

explanation.es:
Hablar de la impresión que da alguien

come across as + adj./sust.He comes across as rather smug. (da la impresión de ser)
strike sb asShe struck me as very perceptive. (me pareció)
give the impression of + -ingHe gives the impression of being shy, but he isn't.

Adjetivos compuestos

Muy productivos en inglés: self- (self-conscious, self-centred), -minded (open-minded, narrow-minded), -tempered (bad-tempered), -going (easy-going), -hearted (kind-hearted).

Colocaciones adverbio + adjetivo

deeply religious / offended · utterly ruthless · painfully shy · mildly amused · fiercely independent · blissfully unaware
En C1 se valora el matiz: en lugar de very shy, usa painfully shy; en lugar de very independent, fiercely independent.
Falsos amigos: sensible = sensato (sensible en español = sensitive); sympathetic = comprensivo (simpático = nice, friendly); eventual = final.

examples.en: He comes across as arrogant, but he's actually very shy.
examples.es: Parece arrogante, pero en realidad es muy tímido.

examples.en: She struck me as someone who doesn't suffer fools gladly.
examples.es: Me pareció alguien que no aguanta a los tontos.

examples.en: He's painfully shy and hardly ever speaks in meetings.
examples.es: Es tremendamente tímido y casi nunca habla en las reuniones.

examples.en: She's fiercely independent and hates asking for help.
examples.es: Es ferozmente independiente y odia pedir ayuda.

examples.en: He gives the impression of being rather headstrong.
examples.es: Da la impresión de ser bastante testarudo.

examples.en: She was blissfully unaware of the problem.
examples.es: Era felizmente ajena al problema.

title.en: Never / Rarely / Seldom + auxiliar + sujeto · Not only… but also · No sooner… than / Hardly… when · Only then / Only after / Not until · Little did…

summary.es: Never / Rarely / Seldom + auxiliar + sujeto · Not only… but also · No sooner… than / Hardly… when · Only then / Only after / Not until · Little did…

explanation.es:
¿Qué es la inversión?

Cuando una frase empieza por un adverbio negativo o restrictivo, el orden pasa a ser el de una pregunta: auxiliar + sujeto + verbo. Es propia del registro formal y escrito, y da mucho énfasis.

Never (before) / Rarely / SeldomNever have I seen such chaos.
Not only … but (also)Not only did he lie, but he also blamed me.
No sooner … thanNo sooner had I sat down than the phone rang.
Hardly / Scarcely / Barely … whenHardly had we arrived when it started to rain.
Only then / Only after / Only whenOnly then did I realise my mistake.
Not untilNot until the next day did she call.
LittleLittle did she know what was waiting for her.
Under no circumstances / On no accountUnder no circumstances should you open this door.
Si no hay auxiliar (presente o pasado simple), se usa do / does / did: Rarely does she complain.
Con Only after / Not until la inversión va en la oración principal, no en la subordinada: ✓ Only after he left did I notice. ✗ Only after did he leave I noticed.

examples.en: Never have I seen such a beautiful sunset.
examples.es: Nunca había visto una puesta de sol tan bonita.

examples.en: No sooner had she left than it started snowing.
examples.es: Nada más irse ella, empezó a nevar.

examples.en: Little did he know that he was being followed.
examples.es: Poco sabía él que lo estaban siguiendo.

examples.en: Under no circumstances should you leave the building.
examples.es: Bajo ninguna circunstancia debe salir del edificio.

examples.en: Rarely does she lose her temper.
examples.es: Rara vez pierde los nervios.

examples.en: Only then did I understand what had happened.
examples.es: Solo entonces entendí lo que había pasado.

title.en: It is/was … that/who · What … is/was · All (that) … is · The thing / reason / place … is · What happened was (that)
title.es: Lo que necesito es un descanso

summary.es: It is/was … that/who · What … is/was · All (that) … is · The thing / reason / place … is · What happened was (that)

explanation.es:
Partir la frase para dar énfasis

Una cleft sentence divide una oración en dos partes para poner el foco en un elemento.

It is/was X that/who …Tom broke the vase → It was Tom who broke the vase (no yo).
What + sujeto + verbo + is/was …I need a holiday → What I need is a holiday.
All (that) … is/was …All I want is some peace and quiet. (lo único que)
The thing / reason / place / person …The reason (why) I left was the noise.
What happened was (that) …What happened was that the train broke down.
What + sujeto + did was … (acciones)What she did was (to) call the police.
Para destacar una acción usa What … do/did is/was + infinitivo: What you should do is apologise.
«Lo que» al principio de frase es What, no That ni Which: ✗ That I don't understand is… → ✓ What I don't understand is…

examples.en: What I don't understand is why she didn't tell us.
examples.es: Lo que no entiendo es por qué no nos lo dijo.

examples.en: It was my sister who found the solution, not me.
examples.es: Fue mi hermana quien encontró la solución, no yo.

examples.en: All I want is a bit of peace and quiet.
examples.es: Lo único que quiero es un poco de paz y tranquilidad.

examples.en: What you need to do is talk to her directly.
examples.es: Lo que tienes que hacer es hablar con ella directamente.

examples.en: The reason I left was the noise.
examples.es: La razón por la que me fui fue el ruido.

examples.en: What really annoys me is his attitude.
examples.es: Lo que de verdad me molesta es su actitud.

title.en: needn't have vs didn't need to · was/were to have done · be bound to / be sure to · might as well · may/might well · should (formal, sorpresa)
title.es: No hacía falta que te molestaras

summary.es: needn't have vs didn't need to · was/were to have done · be bound to / be sure to · might as well · may/might well · should (formal, sorpresa)

explanation.es:
Necesidad en el pasado: dos significados distintos

needn't have + participioYou needn't have bought wine. (lo compraste, pero no hacía falta)
didn't need to + infinitivoI didn't need to buy wine. (no hacía falta, y normalmente no lo compré)

Probabilidad con matices

be bound to / be sure toIt's bound to rain. (seguro que)
may/might/could wellShe may well be right. (es muy posible)
might as well / may as wellThe bus has gone; we might as well walk. (ya puestos)
can't have / must haveHe can't have forgotten; I reminded him twice.

Planes que no se cumplieron

We were to have married in June, but the wedding was cancelled. (íbamos a…)
should tras It's strange / odd / surprising that expresa sorpresa: It's odd that he should say that.
«Debe de haber» = must have (deducción), no should have (crítica): She must have left (seguro que se fue) / She should have left (debería haberse ido).

examples.en: You needn't have cooked; we'd already eaten.
examples.es: No hacía falta que cocinaras; ya habíamos comido.

examples.en: Don't worry, she's bound to call you back.
examples.es: No te preocupes, seguro que te devuelve la llamada.

examples.en: There's nothing on TV. We might as well go to bed.
examples.es: No hay nada en la tele. Ya puestos, nos vamos a la cama.

examples.en: He can't have taken the keys; they were in my pocket all day.
examples.es: No puede haberse llevado las llaves; estuvieron en mi bolsillo todo el día.

examples.en: They were to have opened the shop last spring.
examples.es: Iban a abrir la tienda la primavera pasada.

examples.en: It's strange that he should say such a thing.
examples.es: Es raro que diga algo así.

title.en: have/get sth done · have sb do / get sb to do · pasiva con verbos de opinión (is said to have) · pasiva de infinitivo y gerundio (to be done, being done) · need + -ing
title.es: Encargar que te hagan las cosas

summary.es: have/get sth done · have sb do / get sb to do · pasiva con verbos de opinión (is said to have) · pasiva de infinitivo y gerundio (to be done, being done) · need + -ing

explanation.es:
Estructuras causativas

have / get + objeto + participioI had my car repaired. (me lo arreglaron)
have + persona + infinitivo sin toI'll have the plumber look at it.
get + persona + to + infinitivoI got my brother to help me. (conseguí que)
have sth done (algo malo que te pasa)She had her bag stolen. (le robaron el bolso)

Pasiva con verbos de opinión

Muy usada en noticias: It is said / believed / thought / reported that… o Sujeto + is said to + infinitivo.

The minister is believed to be abroad. (presente)
The thieves are thought to have escaped by car. (pasado → to have + participio)

Infinitivo y gerundio pasivos

I hate being interrupted. · She expects to be paid on time. · The house needs painting (= needs to be painted).
«Me corté el pelo» en la peluquería es I had my hair cut; I cut my hair significa que lo hiciste tú.

examples.en: We're having the kitchen refurbished next month.
examples.es: Nos van a reformar la cocina el mes que viene.

examples.en: I finally got the landlord to fix the boiler.
examples.es: Por fin conseguí que el casero arreglara la caldera.

examples.en: The painting is said to have been stolen in 1990.
examples.es: Se dice que el cuadro fue robado en 1990.

examples.en: This shirt needs ironing .
examples.es: Esta camisa necesita plancharse.

examples.en: I hate being told what to do.
examples.es: Odio que me digan lo que tengo que hacer.

examples.en: We had the roof inspected before buying the house.
examples.es: Hicimos que inspeccionaran el tejado antes de comprar la casa.

title.en: Had / Should / Were + sujeto (inversión) · provided / providing / as long as / on condition that · but for / otherwise / supposing · if it weren't for / if it hadn't been for

summary.es: Had / Should / Were + sujeto (inversión) · provided / providing / as long as / on condition that · but for / otherwise / supposing · if it weren't for / if it hadn't been for

explanation.es:
Condicionales con inversión (formal)

Se elimina if y se invierte el auxiliar:

Had I known, I would have come.= If I had known…
Should you need help, call me.= If you (should) need… (formal, por si acaso)
Were I in your position, I'd resign.= If I were…
Were he to find out, he'd be furious.= If he found out…

Alternativas a if

Provided / Providing (that) you pay on time, there's no problem.
As long as / So long as you're happy, I'm happy.
On condition that he apologises.
Supposing you lost your job, what would you do?
But for your help, we'd have failed. (de no ser por)
Hurry up, otherwise we'll miss the train.
If it weren't for (presente) / If it hadn't been for (pasado) = de no ser por. Con inversión: Had it not been for the rain…
En la inversión negativa not va detrás del sujeto y sin contracción: ✓ Had I not seen it… ✗ Hadn't I seen it…

examples.en: Had I known about the strike, I would have taken the car.
examples.es: De haber sabido lo de la huelga, habría cogido el coche.

examples.en: Should you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact us.
examples.es: Si tiene alguna pregunta, no dude en ponerse en contacto con nosotros.

examples.en: You can borrow the car provided you bring it back by six.
examples.es: Puedes llevarte el coche siempre que lo devuelvas antes de las seis.

examples.en: But for your advice, I'd have made a terrible mistake.
examples.es: De no ser por tu consejo, habría cometido un error terrible.

examples.en: Supposing you won the lottery, what would you do?
examples.es: Suponiendo que ganaras la lotería, ¿qué harías?

examples.en: Leave now, otherwise you'll miss the last bus.
examples.es: Vete ya; si no, perderás el último autobús.

title.en: phrasal verbs separables e inseparables · phrasal verbs de tres partes (put up with, come up with) · sustantivos derivados (breakdown, outcome, setback)

summary.es: phrasal verbs separables e inseparables · phrasal verbs de tres partes (put up with, come up with) · sustantivos derivados (breakdown, outcome, setback)

explanation.es:
Separables e inseparables

Con los separables, si el objeto es un pronombre va en medio: turn it down (✗ turn down it). Los inseparables nunca se parten: look into it, run into her.

bring upsacar (un tema); criar
rule outdescartar
iron outlimar (problemas)
play downquitar importancia
phase outeliminar gradualmente
step downdimitir, apartarse
live up toestar a la altura de
brush up onrepasar, refrescar

Sustantivos a partir de phrasal verbs

break down → a breakdown · set back → a setback · turn out → the turnout · come out → the outcome · cut back → cutbacks · take over → a takeover
Los de tres partes (put up with, come up with, get on with, look forward to) son siempre inseparables y el objeto va al final.
✗ I'll think it over it. ✓ I'll think it over. Con el pronombre en medio, no se repite al final.

examples.en: I don't think we can rule out the possibility of a strike.
examples.es: No creo que podamos descartar la posibilidad de una huelga.

examples.en: The film didn't live up to my expectations.
examples.es: La película no estuvo a la altura de mis expectativas.

examples.en: The government tried to play down the seriousness of the crisis.
examples.es: El gobierno intentó quitarle importancia a la gravedad de la crisis.

examples.en: I need to brush up on my French before the trip.
examples.es: Tengo que repasar mi francés antes del viaje.

examples.en: We still need to iron out a few problems.
examples.es: Aún tenemos que limar algunos problemas.

examples.en: I can't put up with this noise any longer.
examples.es: No aguanto más este ruido.

title.en: nominalización (decide → decision; fail → failure) · verbos de apoyo (make a decision, carry out an investigation) · registro formal vs informal (obtain / get, commence / start)
title.es: La puesta en marcha del plan

summary.es: nominalización (decide → decision; fail → failure) · verbos de apoyo (make a decision, carry out an investigation) · registro formal vs informal (obtain / get, commence / start)

explanation.es:
De verbos a sustantivos

El inglés académico y administrativo prefiere los sustantivos a los verbos: concentra más información y suena más objetivo.

The council decided to close the library, and residents protested.
→ The council's decision to close the library provoked protests from residents.
implement → implementationassess → assessment
comply → compliancefail → failure
reluctant → reluctanceable → ability

Verbos de apoyo

make a decision / a contribution · carry out research / an investigation · give consideration to · reach an agreement · raise a concern

Registro formal

getobtain
startcommence
tryendeavour
beforeprior to
aftersubsequent to
helpfacilitate / assist
No abuses: demasiadas nominalizaciones vuelven el texto pesado. En una carta formal busca equilibrio, no acumules -tion tras -tion.

examples.en: The implementation of the new policy has been delayed.
examples.es: La puesta en marcha de la nueva política se ha retrasado.

examples.en: Her reluctance to accept the offer surprised everyone.
examples.es: Su reticencia a aceptar la oferta sorprendió a todos.

examples.en: The committee will make a decision next week.
examples.es: El comité tomará una decisión la semana que viene.

examples.en: Applicants must obtain a permit prior to arrival.
examples.es: Los solicitantes deben obtener un permiso antes de su llegada.

examples.en: Failure to comply with these rules may result in a fine.
examples.es: El incumplimiento de estas normas puede acarrear una multa.

examples.en: The proposal received the endorsement of the board.
examples.es: La propuesta recibió el respaldo de la junta.

title.en: seem / appear to · tend to, may, might, could · It could be argued that… · to some extent, arguably, somewhat · vague language: sort of, -ish, or so, and so on

summary.es: seem / appear to · tend to, may, might, could · It could be argued that… · to some extent, arguably, somewhat · vague language: sort of, -ish, or so, and so on

explanation.es:
¿Por qué suavizar?

En inglés académico y profesional, las afirmaciones rotundas suenan arrogantes o poco rigurosas. El hedging permite expresar prudencia.

seem / appear toThe results appear to confirm the theory.
It would seem / appear thatIt would seem that there has been a mistake.
It could be argued thatIt could be argued that the plan is too expensive.
tend toYoung people tend to be more flexible.
to some extent / to a certain degreeI agree to some extent.
arguablyShe is arguably the best writer of her generation. (se podría decir que)

Lenguaje vago (informal)

There were twenty or so people. · It's sort of blueish. · Come at six-ish. · We talked about work, family and so on / and stuff like that.
Combinar mecanismos refuerza la cautela: This maypartly explain why…
apparently = al parecer, según dicen; no significa «aparentemente» en el sentido de «a simple vista falso». Para eso usa seemingly u on the surface.

examples.en: The new drug appears to have fewer side effects.
examples.es: El nuevo fármaco parece tener menos efectos secundarios.

examples.en: It could be argued that the policy has failed.
examples.es: Se podría argumentar que la política ha fracasado.

examples.en: I agree with you to some extent .
examples.es: Estoy de acuerdo contigo hasta cierto punto.

examples.en: There were fifty or so people at the meeting.
examples.es: Había unas cincuenta personas en la reunión.

examples.en: It would seem that nobody read the instructions.
examples.es: Parecería que nadie leyó las instrucciones.

examples.en: This is arguably his most important novel.
examples.es: Se podría decir que es su novela más importante.

title.en: so / neither / nor + auxiliar · so / not como sustitutos (I think so, I hope not) · one / ones · do so · elipsis tras auxiliares y to (I'd love to)

summary.es: so / neither / nor + auxiliar · so / not como sustitutos (I think so, I hope not) · one / ones · do so · elipsis tras auxiliares y to (I'd love to)

explanation.es:
Sustituir con so / not

I think so / I don't think socreo que sí / creo que no
I hope so / I hope notespero que sí / espero que no
I'm afraid so / I'm afraid notme temo que sí / me temo que no
I suppose so / I suppose notsupongo que sí / supongo que no

Elipsis tras auxiliares y «to»

"Are you coming?" "I'd love to." (no se repite come)
She said she'd call, but she didn't.
I haven't finished yet, but I will have by Friday.

one / ones · do so · the former / the latter

I don't like the red shoes; I prefer the black ones.
He promised to help and he did so. (formal)
Cats and dogs: the former are independent, the latter loyal.
I hope not, no I don't hope so. En cambio con think, believe, expect lo natural es I don't think so.

examples.en: "Will it rain tomorrow?" "I hope not ."
examples.es: —¿Lloverá mañana? —Espero que no.

examples.en: "Do you want to come?" "I'd love to ."
examples.es: —¿Quieres venir? —Me encantaría.

examples.en: I don't like this jacket. Can I see the blue one ?
examples.es: No me gusta esta chaqueta. ¿Puedo ver la azul?

examples.en: "I didn't enjoy the film." "Neither did I."
examples.es: —No me gustó la película. —A mí tampoco.

examples.en: She said she would help us, and she did.
examples.es: Dijo que nos ayudaría, y lo hizo.

examples.en: I don't think so, but I may be wrong.
examples.es: No creo, pero puede que me equivoque.

title.en: albeit, whereas, whilst · even so, nonetheless, nevertheless · much as / adj. + as + sujeto + verbo (concesión) · hence, thus, consequently · given that, in view of, owing to

summary.es: albeit, whereas, whilst · even so, nonetheless, nevertheless · much as / adj. + as + sujeto + verbo (concesión) · hence, thus, consequently · given that, in view of, owing to

explanation.es:
Contraste y concesión

albeit (+ adj./adv.)a small, albeit important, change (aunque)
whereas / whilstI love cities, whereas my wife prefers the country.
nonetheless / nevertheless / even soIt was risky. Nevertheless, we did it.
Much as + sujeto + verboMuch as I like him, I can't trust him. (por mucho que)
Adj. + as/though + sujeto + verboTired as she was, she kept going. (aunque estaba cansada)
admittedly / grantedAdmittedly, it's expensive, but it's worth it.

Causa y consecuencia

Owing to / Due to / In view of the weather, the match was cancelled.
Given that nobody came, we left early.
Costs rose; hence the price increase. (de ahí)
The data was incomplete, and thus unreliable.
irrespective of / regardless of = independientemente de: Everyone pays the same, irrespective of income.
Owing to va seguido de sustantivo o -ing, no de una oración: ✗ owing to it rained → ✓ owing to the rain / owing to the fact that it rained.

examples.en: Much as I admire her work, I don't agree with her.
examples.es: Por mucho que admire su trabajo, no estoy de acuerdo con ella.

examples.en: It was a slow, albeit steady, improvement.
examples.es: Fue una mejora lenta, aunque constante.

examples.en: The flight was cancelled owing to a technical fault.
examples.es: El vuelo se canceló debido a una avería técnica.

examples.en: Prices have risen sharply; hence the drop in sales.
examples.es: Los precios han subido mucho; de ahí la caída de las ventas.

examples.en: Admittedly, the hotel was expensive, but the service was excellent.
examples.es: Hay que reconocer que el hotel era caro, pero el servicio era excelente.

examples.en: Given that it was late, we decided to take a taxi.
examples.es: Dado que era tarde, decidimos coger un taxi.

title.en: prefijos negativos y de grado (mis-, dis-, under-, over-, out-, counter-) · sufijos (-hood, -ship, -ness, -ity, -ism, -ise, -en) · adjetivos en -ive, -ous, -ible/-able

summary.es: prefijos negativos y de grado (mis-, dis-, under-, over-, out-, counter-) · sufijos (-hood, -ship, -ness, -ity, -ism, -ise, -en) · adjetivos en -ive, -ous, -ible/-able

explanation.es:
Prefijos con significado

mis- (mal)misunderstand, misinterpret, misplace, mislead
under- / over- (poco / demasiado)underestimate, overcook, overrated, underpaid
out- (superar)outnumber, outlive, outgrow, outperform
counter- (contra)counterproductive, counterattack, counterpart
re- (otra vez)rethink, rediscover, recharge, reassure

Sufijos que cambian la categoría

Verbo: wide → widen, strong → strengthen, modern → modernise
Sustantivo abstracto: child → childhood, friend → friendship, close → closeness, simple → simplicity, likely → likelihood
Adjetivo: create → creative, danger → dangerous, recognise → recognisable, flex → flexible
En los ejercicios de word formation de la EOI, fíjate en qué categoría pide el hueco (artículo delante → sustantivo; verbo be delante → adjetivo) y si la frase necesita sentido negativo o plural.
Ojo con la ortografía: strong → strength → strengthen, long → length → lengthen, high → height → heighten.

examples.en: Never underestimate the importance of a good night's sleep.
examples.es: Nunca subestimes la importancia de dormir bien.

examples.en: In our team, women outnumber men by three to one.
examples.es: En nuestro equipo, las mujeres superan en número a los hombres tres a uno.

examples.en: The council wants to widen the road to reduce traffic jams.
examples.es: El ayuntamiento quiere ensanchar la carretera para reducir los atascos.

examples.en: There's little likelihood of them winning the match.
examples.es: Hay pocas probabilidades de que ganen el partido.

examples.en: His explanation was completely misleading.
examples.es: Su explicación era totalmente engañosa.

examples.en: The scandal has heightened tension between the two parties.
examples.es: El escándalo ha intensificado la tensión entre los dos partidos.

title.en: binomios fijos (pros and cons, by and large) · colocaciones adjetivo + sustantivo (heavy traffic, strong coffee) · verbo + sustantivo (pay attention, reach a verdict) · adverbio + adjetivo (bitterly cold)

summary.es: binomios fijos (pros and cons, by and large) · colocaciones adjetivo + sustantivo (heavy traffic, strong coffee) · verbo + sustantivo (pay attention, reach a verdict) · adverbio + adjetivo (bitterly cold)

explanation.es:
Binomios: pares fijos

Su orden no se puede cambiar: decimos salt and pepper, nunca pepper and salt.

safe and soundsano y salvo
pros and consventajas e inconvenientes
ups and downsaltibajos
sick and tiredharto
trial and errorensayo y error
odds and ends / bits and piecescosas sueltas, cachivaches
short and sweetbreve y al grano
by and largeen general
sooner or latertarde o temprano
rough and readyrudimentario, improvisado

Colocaciones fuertes

heavy traffic / rain / smoker · strong coffee / accent · bitterly cold / disappointed · highly unlikely / recommended · deeply moved · reach a verdict · pay a compliment · draw a conclusion · meet a deadline
«Lluvia fuerte» no es strong rain sino heavy rain; «gran fumador» es heavy smoker; «muy recomendable» es highly recommended.

examples.en: After hours of searching, they found the children safe and sound .
examples.es: Tras horas de búsqueda, encontraron a los niños sanos y salvos.

examples.en: I'm sick and tired of hearing the same excuses.
examples.es: Estoy harto de oír las mismas excusas.

examples.en: It's highly unlikely that they'll arrive on time.
examples.es: Es muy poco probable que lleguen a tiempo.

examples.en: The jury took two days to reach a verdict.
examples.es: El jurado tardó dos días en llegar a un veredicto.

examples.en: Every relationship has its ups and downs.
examples.es: Toda relación tiene sus altibajos.

examples.en: By and large, the project was a success.
examples.es: En general, el proyecto fue un éxito.

title.en: idioms de cuerpo, animales y colores · expresiones con verbos comunes (get the hang of, take for granted) · cuándo usarlos (registro informal)
title.es: No hay mal que por bien no venga

summary.es: idioms de cuerpo, animales y colores · expresiones con verbos comunes (get the hang of, take for granted) · cuándo usarlos (registro informal)

explanation.es:
Algunos idioms imprescindibles

a blessing in disguiseno hay mal que por bien no venga
a piece of cakepan comido
break the iceromper el hielo

Los idioms son coloquiales. En una redacción formal de la EOI úsalos con moderación; en la interacción oral, uno o dos bien colocados suben la nota.
No se traducen palabra por palabra. «Llueve a cántaros» es it's pouring (down); it's raining cats and dogs existe pero hoy suena anticuado.

title.en: do / does / did enfático · adverbios de comentario (frankly, admittedly, understandably) · so + adj. / such (a) + adj. + sust. · whatever / whoever / however · not that…

summary.es: do / does / did enfático · adverbios de comentario (frankly, admittedly, understandably) · so + adj. / such (a) + adj. + sust. · whatever / whoever / however · not that…

explanation.es:
Do enfático

En afirmativa, do / does / did + infinitivo refuerza o contradice: I do like your dress! (¡me encanta de verdad!) · She did call; you just didn't hear it.

Adverbios de comentario

Muestran tu actitud ante toda la frase y suelen ir al principio con coma:

Frankly, I don't care. · Understandably, she was upset. · Ironically, the fire station burnt down. · Regrettably, we cannot accept your offer.

so / such

It was so cold (that) we stayed in. · It was such a cold day (that)… · such beautiful weather (incontable, sin a)

whatever / however / whoever

Whatever you do, don't tell her. (hagas lo que hagas)
However hard I try, I can't remember. (por mucho que)
Whoever wins, it'll be a great match.
Not that… introduce una aclaración: He didn't invite me — not that I wanted to go. (no es que quisiera ir)
✗ such cold weather day; ✓ such a cold day / such cold weather. Such necesita sustantivo; so, adjetivo o adverbio solos.

title.en: would rather + sujeto + pasado · it's (high/about) time + pasado · as if / as though · wish / if only + pasado / pasado perfecto / would · suppose / imagine + pasado

summary.es: would rather + sujeto + pasado · it's (high/about) time + pasado · as if / as though · wish / if only + pasado / pasado perfecto / would · suppose / imagine + pasado

explanation.es:
Pasado con valor de presente

would rather + sujeto + pasadoI'd rather you didn't smoke here. (preferiría que no)
it's (high / about) time + sujeto + pasadoIt's high time you got a job. (ya va siendo hora)
as if / as though + pasadoHe talks as if he knew everything.
suppose / imagine + pasadoSuppose you lost your job…

wish / if only

+ pasado (presente irreal)I wish I had more time.
+ pasado perfecto (lamento pasado)If only I had listened to you!
+ would (queja sobre otros)I wish you would stop interrupting.
Con el mismo sujeto, would rather va con infinitivo sin to: I'd rather stay at home. Con sujeto distinto, pasado: I'd rather you stayed.
No se dice I wish I would… para uno mismo: ✗ I wish I would be taller → ✓ I wish I were taller.
